name: 十回の学習の進み方
prompt: Make a color-only correction to this ten-step tracker. Preserve the image dimensions, exact layout, circles, checkmarks, play symbols, labels, spacing, and typography. Flatten the status colors completely: steps 1 and 2 each use one uniform solid fill #30964B (RGB 48,150,75), step 3 uses one uniform solid fill #2D6CF7 (RGB 45,108,247). Remove all gradients, tonal tints, highlights, darkening, texture, glow and shadows from those fills. Keep steps 4–10 as white circles with neutral gray outlines and solid neutral gray play symbols. Keep text as in the input. This must look like simple flat status colors on pure white, with no pale or colored wash on any surface. Do not change anything else.
reviewNotes: Owner requested no tint colors. Flat green completed states, flat blue current state, and neutral-gray upcoming states follow the attached preference. Minor within-fill sample variance is visually negligible. Catalog candidate only; native editability, app implementation and owner approval are not claimed.
reviewNotice: 画像生成候補。ネイティブ編集・実装・所有者承認とは別です。
